# API conventions (`/api/v1`)

* Contract: [`contracts/openapi.json`](../contracts/openapi.json) (generated by
  `backend/scripts/export_openapi.py`; CI fails on drift). Web types are generated from it (`npm run gen:api`).
* Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <Keycloak access token>`; `X-Tenant-ID: <uuid>` on `/api/v1/tenant/**`;
  `X-Correlation-ID: <uuid>` optional (echoed back, generated when absent); `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` required on
  money/onboarding/creation endpoints (same key + same body ⇒ stored response replayed; different body ⇒
  `409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH`).
* Errors (all non-2xx): `{"error": {"code", "message", "correlation_id", "details": [{"field", "issue"}]}}`.
  Codes are stable identifiers (e.g. `TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_READ_ONLY`, `ALREADY_ENROLLED`).
* Lists: `page` (1-based), `page_size` (≤200), `q`, `sort` (`-field` = descending) →
  `{"items", "total", "page", "page_size"}`.
* Money: decimal strings at storage scale (4 dp); clients format with the currency's minor units. Never floats.
* Dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`; instants are UTC ISO-8601.
* Route groups: `/health/*` (unauthenticated probes), `/me`, `/platform/**` (platform scope), `/tenant/**`
  (tenant scope).
